senses.gloss: [challa, text in Mv 〔ii.125.8〕 kola-challaṃ pi āhāram āharanti; so one ms., but v.l. kolaṃ curṇṇa, which clearly points to kola-cūrṇaṃ = Pali kola-cuṇṇaṃ, MN 〔i.80.3〕 in a closely parallel passage; so read; powder of jujube-berries. Senart assumes a m. or nt. equivalent of challi, bark (Pali, late and lex. Skt., see Schmidt, Nachträge.)]
